svg.title: Map service dependency impact
svg.desc: Trace an inventory transaction through five dependency categories. Local execution needs virtual machines with accessible storage. Azure resource management authorizes changes that local management components apply. Identity services authenticate users, workloads. Network services provide name resolution, routing, proxy access. Telemetry provides health evidence through collection, delivery. Failures can interrupt transactions, management requests, authentication, service calls, operational visibility respectively. These are dependency categories, not sequential network hops. Record the caller, service location, authentication method, network path, restoration owner, acceptable interruption for each dependency. A cloud management outage does not prove local application failure.

svg.text: Read top to bottom. Arrows link dependencies to potential failure effects.
Example: record an inventory movement. Assess each dependency separately.
Cached sessions can hide the outage.
Missing alerts do not prove health.
Capture caller, service location, authentication method, network path.
Assign a restoration owner. Define acceptable interruption.
Azure authorization differs from workload sign-in.
Cloud management loss does not prove local application failure.
